prerequisites.required: Port actual Electron43.2.0 Chromium150+Node24/libuv and native PE/CRT/process/IPC/text/graphics/network primitives to Win98; changing Windows version checks is insufficient.
Frozen actual Legcord entry in an exact ia32 Electron runtime with app.disableHardwareAcceleration before app startup; no mock Discord UI.
Real Node async filesystem/network/process/pipe/completion and threadpool semantics; do not infer these from old static import coverage.
Make updater/native game detection/venmic/screen capture optional source features in the frozen Legcord build. Unsupported hooks must fail explicitly; no current compatibility claim.
Actual Legcord webContents loads and renders the Discord UI using the ported Electron runtime. A local fixture is a preceding engine test, not a Discord PASS.

acceptance: Frozen ia32 Electron/Legcord/source/package lock/native dependency provenance and actual Win98 OS/nonce proof.
Actual Legcord startup/main+preload/renderer IPC, real Discord login UI and network/certificate/WebSocket behavior in separately authorized network scope.
Real typed input, navigation and UI state readback without sending account messages unless explicitly authorized.
Optional capture/game detection/updater feature scope recorded, owned processes/threads shut down and external exit observed.
